name: train-booking-platform
description: A small train booking platform with 4 microservices

scripts.dev: concurrently -n booking,schedule,payment,notification,weather -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "FORCE_COLOR=1 node services/booking/index.js" "FORCE_COLOR=1 node services/schedule/index.js" "FORCE_COLOR=1 node services/payment/index.js" "FORCE_COLOR=1 node services/notification/index.js" "FORCE_COLOR=1 node services/weather/index.js"
scripts.mocks:start: concurrently -n schedule-mock,payment-mock,notification-mock,openweather-mock -c green,yellow,magenta,cyan "postman mock start postman/mocks/schedule-mock.json" "postman mock start postman/mocks/payment-mock.json" "postman mock start postman/mocks/notification-mock.json" "postman mock start postman/mocks/openweather-mock.json"
